processes.tw_contract_amendment_request: Commercial account director receives a shipper request to change a transportation contract (receipts, MDQ, name, volumes), approves it and forwards it to Gas Logistics/contract administration to generate amendments and update records.
processes.california_capacity_weekly_report: Weekly compilation and distribution of California deliveries, capacity utilization and posted Gas Daily prices for Transwestern and El Paso.
processes.tw_credit_approval_request: Credit approval requests for shipper capacity are submitted to credit/CAS and circulated to the commercial team for review.
processes.capacity_release_billing_adjustment: Working out and reviewing manual invoice adjustments and marketing-fee revenue for capacity releases before billing.
processes.capacity_posting_review: Reviewing and chasing availability and timeliness of firm capacity postings and bid deadlines.
